1 case in crates/reflow2-core/tests/orphan_attachment.rs. Asserts the `orphan_node` repair note names `parks`, says the ruling must be ACCEPTED, warns against deleting the node, AND names what parking does not reach (`unthreaded_cluster`).

PINNED AS A TEST BECAUSE MESSAGE TEXT REGRESSES SILENTLY — nothing else in the suite would notice the sentence going away, and its absence is what cost two registered documents. The boundary assertion is not padding: a mechanism named WITHOUT its scope produced the other half of the same day's failure, where a reporter found `parks`, could not confirm it covered their case, and did nothing.
properties.name: The orphan finding names parking and its limits
